questions.question: Five friends Anthony, Bunty, Giridhar, Rahul and Tarun are arranged in a row facing north but not necessarily in the same order. Bunty sits at left end of the row. Only two people are sitting between Anthony and Giridhar. Anthony sits immediate next to the Bunty and Rahul sits second to the right of Bunty. Who sits between Rahul and Giridhar?
questions.solution:
Given: Five friends Anthony, Bunty, Giridhar, Rahul and Tarun are arranged in a row facing north but not necessarily in the same order.

1) Bunty sits at left end of the row.

2) Anthony sits immediate next to the Bunty and Rahul sits second to the right of Bunty.

3) Only two people are sitting between Anthony and Giridhar. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/282b5a942e4f7815571ad15caea1c5173e9c33f93c4f05baa0a4a76f9b1e32dc.png] 

And, Tarun will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9ca067ba0f740e4dd7d5413e102373c86f081b9bc2aac7bf07981f84223c181.png] 

So, 'Tarun sits between Rahul and Giridhar.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some facebook are WhatsApp.

All messenger are WhatsApp.

**Conclusions:**

I. All WhatsApp are messenger.

II. Some facebook are messenger.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some facebook are WhatsApp.

All messenger are WhatsApp.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f02d610c045a608411515ce61e517ad328967850ad306b731ed378199069c745.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All WhatsApp are messenger - False (Because, All messenger are WhatsApp implies that some WhatsApp are messenger, but All WhatsApp are messenger can be possible only).

II. Some facebook are messenger - False (Because, No definite relation given between facebook and messenger, so it can be possible only).

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row - 8, 32, 64

Second row - 7, 28, 56

Third row - 12, 48, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number **×** **4 **= 2nd number.

2nd number × 2 = 3rd number.

Now,

First row - 8, 32, 64

→ 8 × 4 = 32.

→ 32 × 2 = 64.

Second row - 7, 28, 56

→ 7 × 4 = 28.

→ 28 × 2 = 56.

Similarly, for **Third row - 12, 48, ?**

**→ 12 × 4 = 48.**

**→ 48 × 2 = 96.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Among five friends Poonam, Neha, Rekha, Shruti and Twinkle, Twinkle is taller than only three other friends. Rekha is tallest among all friends. Neha is taller than only one person. Only two persons are taller than Poonam. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
questions.solution:
Given: Among five friends Poonam, Neha, Rekha, Shruti and Twinkle. 

1) Rekha is tallest among all friends.

Rekha > __ > __ > __ > __

2) Neha is taller than only one person.

Rekha > __ > __ > Neha > __

3) Twinkle is taller than only three other friends. 

Rekha > Twinkle > __ > Neha > __

4) Only two persons are taller than Poonam.

Rekha > Twinkle > Poonam > Neha > __

And, the remaining person will be Shruti among the friends.

Rekha > Twinkle > Poonam > Neha > Shruti

So, 'Shruti' is the shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
